title: web service gives EOF during sensor warm-up
body:
Local web service produces an incorrect error response during sensor warm-up. The xDrip log shows it encounters an internal server error, but it does not return a correct HTTP error page -- instead it terminates the connection, causing an unexpected EOF on the client.

Versions tried: 20210308-17cbcf0, 20210717-05352f5
Hardware: Dexcom G6, xDrip running on Pixel 3a XL with Android 11
Web client is a Raspberry Pi-based closed loop system that queries the phone every 5 minutes for SGV values.

Expected behavior:
The most recent SGV values, from before the sensor change, or an empty JSON list of values, or a 400- or 500-series error page.

Actual behavior:
The client reports an unexpected EOF on the HTTP connection.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Query the sgv.json endpoint during sensor warm-up.
